added_lines: . the rosary will be recited every tuesday morning after the 9 30 am mass during the month of october . coming home for christmas: a special christmas concert with tenor gavan ring and soprano nicola ring accompanied on piano by gary beecher: friday dec 4th 7 30pm in the o’connell memorial church, cahersiveen. tickets €30. contact the parish office . divine mercy retreat at the oratory, waterville starting at 7pm fri 30th oct & at 9 30am sat 31st oct. all welcome. rte mass will be broadcast from the o’connell memorial church on wed oct 28th at 10 30 am on channel 517. acknowledgement: €2,000 sent to the columban fathers for 200 individual masses. thank you for supporting the missions it is always acknowledged and very much appreciated. mass intentions for 2027 are now being taken. please contact the parish office. synodal evaluation assemble 2027: why are we holding an assembly? pope leo has asked every diocese to hold a pastoral assembly during the first half of 2027. each diocese is invited to review how it has progressed in becoming a more synodal church – a church in which all the baptised share responsibility for its life and mission. the diocese of kerry will hold its evaluation assembly on sat 10th april 2027. the assembly will review our experience since the publication of the synod’s final document in 2025. it will recognise where synodal ways of working are already developing, identify what may be hindering progress, and agree the next steps needed to strengthen the mission of the diocese. transatlantic cable ensemble unesco world heritage nomination: drop-in clinic mon 2nd nov 7-9pm, tue 3rd 3-5pm & valentia island community group meeting 7-9pm at the royal hotel. kerry county council welcomes members of the public to participate in a planning and demystifying world heritage information clinic regarding the nomination of the transatlantic cable ensemble for unesco world heritage designation. happy halloween! valentia
